# So Much PETential

> > Professional dog and parrot behavior training in Cincinnati using positive reinforcement methods, led by certified trainer Lisa Desatnik with 20+ years of experience.

So Much PETential is a Cincinnati-based pet training and behavior consulting business specializing in customized dog training, puppy training, behavior modification for anxious and aggressive dogs, and parrot behavior support. The business is run by Lisa Desatnik, a CPDT-KA certified professional dog trainer and certified parrot behavior consultant who also offers virtual training sessions and community education programs.

## Key Topics

- Puppy Training
- Behavior Modification

## Core Training Services

- [Dog Training in Cincinnati](https://somuchpetential.com/dog-training): Greater Cincinnati dog training by Lisa Desatnik with positive reinforcement
- [Puppy Training in Cincinnati](https://somuchpetential.com/puppy-training): Customized puppy training in Cincinnati using positive reinforcement
- [Behavior Relief for Dogs](https://somuchpetential.com/behavior-relief): Dog behavior training for fearful, anxious, and aggressive dogs in Cincinnati
- [Virtual Dog & Parrot Training](https://somuchpetential.com/virtual-training): Virtual dog and parrot training via Zoom with Lisa Desatnik
- [Parrot Behavior Support](https://somuchpetential.com/parrot-behavior-support): Parrot behavior consulting in Cincinnati for screaming, biting, and issues

## Specialized Programs

- [Pet Training for Growing Families](https://somuchpetential.com/support-for-growing-families): Dog training for families preparing for new babies with Lisa Desatnik
- [Kids and Dogs Safety Classes](https://somuchpetential.com/kids-and-dogs): Dog safety and training classes for kids in Cincinnati area
- [Community Talks and Programs](https://somuchpetential.com/talks): Free community talks on dog behavior improvement in Cincinnati area
